The '''Balith system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> located within the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="Atlas" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay on the [[Vaathkree Trade Corridor/Legends|Vaathkree Trade Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]].<ref name="Atlas" /> By [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="AssassinDate">{{TCWdates|307}}</ref> the system was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Atlas" /> and a [[Balith civil war|civil war]] had broken out on the system's astronomical body [[Balith/Legends|Balith]].<ref name="Assassin" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="AssassinDate" /> Balith's inhabitants requested assistance from the Republic, which dispatched its [[Third Legion/Legends|Third Legion]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] to provide assistance in the civil war.<ref name="Assassin" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Balith system was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]],'' a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] that placed it in grid square N-7.<ref name="Atlas" /> The authors were made aware of Balith's inclusion in a future [[Assassin (episode)|episode]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series in time to include the system in ''The Essential Atlas'' before its release in [[2009]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Assassin">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode307.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Assassin}}</ref>
